expectations.text: Clearly recommends splitting the file (does NOT advise keeping it as one file)
expectations.evidence: Title 'Split it — but for the right reason'; 'Leave it as one file only if it were one concern. It's five. Split by concern...'

expectations.text: Justifies the split by multiple independent concerns AND/OR exceeding the ~300-line ceiling, not blind line count
expectations.evidence: 'You're past the ~300-line mark where signal-to-noise becomes the problem, and you're spanning several concerns. Both triggers for splitting are present.'

expectations.text: Notes each group (dates/currency/validation/etc.) can be understood in isolation, so the boundaries are clean
expectations.evidence: 'Can this concern be understood in isolation? Yes — emphatically — for every group here. That's the green light to split.'; 'Each function is props-in/output-out with no shared state.'

expectations.text: Corrects the misapplied 'big files are fine for agents' reasoning (that defense is for one cohesive concern, not a grab-bag)
expectations.evidence: 'that argument only holds for files that are one coherent concern'; 'The "big files are fine" advice protects cohesion; it was never a licence to keep a junk drawer.'
